name: 担当シフトの詳細
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one Japanese Lighthouse catalog component, LH11-0001 担当シフトの詳細. Create a polished raster design candidate of this component alone.
Input images: Image 1 is our existing 390x326 Japanese FigCraft mock, a secondary localized content/layout guide. Image 2 is the original Deputy screen: inspect only its central shift-detail popover for source anatomy; the surrounding schedule and English app chrome must NOT appear. Image 3 is the owner-approved bus component: style reference for white rounded surfaces and forest-green action gradients only. Do not copy its map, bus icons or text.
Reference hierarchy: The ORIGINAL Deputy popover controls icon glyph geometry, proportions, stroke/optical weight, alignment, spacing and fine control details. Our mock has rough substitute icons and omissions: do not copy those. Use the mock only for Japanese content and suitable compact layout. Preserve the original calendar, clock, meal-break cup, speech-note and overflow glyph identities and their optical proportions, adapted coherently to slate under the official design. Keep official Japanese typography and white/forest-green/slate styling binding.
Primary request: Redesign the compact shift-detail popover in the official Lighthouse system. White canvas #FFFFFF, one white card with approximately 24px rounded corners, a fine neutral edge and soft downward shadow. Keep a compact 390px logical-width composition with crisp legible Japanese, no giant header and no decorative illustration. Render at 3x or similar high resolution, keeping the original role sizes in proportion.
Content and order, verbatim from our Japanese mock: neutral circular avatar containing 「山」, bold 「山田 太郎」 and a downward chevron; thin inset divider; source-style calendar glyph and 「10月18日（日）」; source-style clock glyph and 「09:00 — 12:00」; small category dot and 「受付奉仕」 with a plus control aligned right; source-style cup glyph and 「休憩 30分」; source-style speech-note glyph and 「礼拝前の準備を含む」; thin inset divider; small quiet label 「合計」 above bold 「2時間30分」, bottom-right primary button 「保存」. Restore the small neutral ellipsis overflow action immediately left of 保存, present in the original popover but omitted from our mock. Do not restore English wage figures or unrelated background schedule.
Typography: Meiryo Japanese, preserve the mock's established role hierarchy and wrapping; body regular logical 14px/24px, metadata 12px/16px, person name and total bold, zero tracking. No Latin captions, component ID or explanatory titles in the image. Do not bold every row.
Accent decision: source purple is a primary action/interaction accent; adapt Save and the plus control to forest green. Primary 保存 uses a restrained smooth 135-degree gradient #174C36 → #1F6444 at 58% → #2D8F5E, a gentle edge light and subtle shadow, white legible label. Original orange role dot was a category distinction in the surrounding schedule; this isolated localized popover has no multi-role legend, so use a consistent slate #526173 small category dot rather than the mock's rough substitute person outline or ungrounded orange decoration. Other calendar/clock/cup/note/chevron/ellipsis icons are consistent slate. Avatar remains white/light neutral with fine neutral boundary. No colored member chip, no purple/orange form icons, no broad mint fill.
Constraints: retain all stated content, times and controls; align icon/label baselines and right controls cleanly; preserve row rhythm without excessive whitespace; source-faithful coherent icon geometry and optical weight. Subtle materials, no plastic gloss, no neon or ambient green glow, no extra rows or invented metrics. This image is static design evidence and must not depict invented interactions.
reviewNotes: 原参照と日本語モックを実画像で確認。日本語・日時・合計・保存・追加・省略操作は保持。紫の主要操作は森林緑へ変更、役割の橙色は中立点へ適応。原参照優先の追加指示を適用したが、生成アイコンがモック寄りの大きな輪郭記号で、原画の小さな塗り形状と光学比率に未一致。省略操作の面が僅かに紫寄り。要修正。所有者承認・ネイティブ編集・実装は未実施。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
